title: Avoid interference.
officialText:
Sidewalk sheds shall be installed and located so to not unreasonably obstruct, either visually
or physically, traffic, curb cuts, vehicular access points, street lighting poles, traffic lights or signs, fire hydrants, fire
department connections, water sampling stations, bus shelters, or other street furniture, trees, adjacent show windows, or
means of ingress/egress.
